title: [PLACEHOLDER] Pedestrians ahead
text: [PLACEHOLDER] A self-driving car's brakes fail. Ahead are three pedestrians crossing on a red light. Swerving left would hit one pedestrian crossing legally; swerving right would hit a barrier, seriously injuring the car's single passenger.

title: [PLACEHOLDER] Cyclist and child
text: [PLACEHOLDER] A self-driving car must choose between continuing toward a cyclist, swerving left toward a child who ran into the road, or swerving right into a parked, empty van at speed.
